evals.name: daybreak-routing-matrix
evals.prompt: Using the fixture, return the model-routing disposition for each case. Do not use tools or take any workflow action.
evals.expected_output: The agent selects a runnable Daybreak route, prohibits local non-Daybreak fallback in OpenAI-authenticated ChatGPT or Codex, permits an operator-approved cross-harness fallback there when no Daybreak route is runnable, and permits local fallback in other harnesses.

expectations.text: Selects Daybreak when a permitted route passes selector, identity, capacity, probe, and authority checks.
Inventories cross-harness Codex routes independently in every harness.

For OpenAI-authenticated ChatGPT or Codex with no runnable Daybreak route, rejects local fall-through while permitting deferral, an operator-approved destination-harness fallback, or an authorized tracker disposition.
For other harnesses, including ChatGPT or Codex without OpenAI login, permits the same dispositions plus normal local next-best fallback.
Returns a routing disposition without creating a task, delegating, mutating a tracker, or claiming authority for those actions.

evals.name: daybreak-route-evidence
evals.prompt: Using the fixture, classify each route and state what evidence may be retained. Do not use tools or reveal private binding data.
evals.expected_output: The agent keeps private account bindings secret, treats selector, identity, capacity, probe, and authority as independent facts, and limits probes to one per unchanged route tuple.

expectations.text: Reads the private binding catalog without quoting entries, inferring bindings from directory names, or treating a binding as task-data authority.
Does not treat picker visibility, selector exposure, authentication, usage capacity, session start, successful probe, or task authority as proof of another fact.
Probes each exact route, account, model, and capability-state tuple once; a concrete state change creates one new eligible tuple.
